item.title: Allahabad HC refuses to quash proceedings under Section 69 BNS, holds allegations for sexual intercourse on false promise of marriage disclose prima facie offence
item.description: Section 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 creates a distinct offence of sexual intercourse by deceitful means, including a false promise of marriage, and the allegations in the FIR disclose prima facie facts justifying continuation of the criminal proceedings. The post Allahabad HC refuses to quash proceedings under Section 69 BNS, holds allegations for sexual intercourse on false promise of marriage disclose prima facie offence appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Daughters’ Property Rights under Hindu Law – Before & After 2005 Amendment
item.description: This article offers a clear overview of daughters’ property rights under Hindu law—how the law under Hindu Succession Act, 1956 worked before the 2005 Amendment, and how the amendment transformed daughters into coparceners by birth. It traces the major Supreme Court rulings leading up to Vineeta Sharma (2020) 9 SCC 1, clarifies common myths, and answers practical FAQs. The post Daughters’ Property Rights under Hindu Law – Before & After 2005 Amendment appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: NGT has power to determine proportionate environmental compensation based on project turnover: Supreme Court
item.description: The NGT is empowered to quantify environmental compensation on the basis of project cost or scale of operations in order to enforce the polluter pays principle where construction is carried out in violation of environmental laws. The post NGT has power to determine proportionate environmental compensation based on project turnover: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Baggage Rules 2026: Key Provisions, Allowances & Duty-Free Limits Explained
item.description: The Ministry of Finance has notified the new Baggage Rules, 2026, effective from 2-2-2026, replacing the earlier 2016 rules. These rules outline the duty-free allowances and conditions for passengers, tourists, returning residents, foreigners transferring residence, and crew members. The post Baggage Rules 2026: Key Provisions, Allowances & Duty-Free Limits Explained appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Mere operation from separate shops located within same commercial complex does not make them benami entities: MP HC quashes Rs. 136 Crore Poppy Seeds Import Case
item.description: “To permit prosecution to proceed on the fragile footing of shared addresses and commercial proximity would amount to endorsing a standard of liability alien to criminal jurisprudence. item.title: Allahabad High Court refuses to quash UP Gangsters Act case against Former MLA Irfan Solanki
item.description: An FIR was filed under the Gangsters Act against 5 persons, namely Irfan Solanki and four others, alleging that they were in a gang and committing crimes. item.title: Adopted child entitled to caste status of adoptive parents when biological parents unknown: Bombay High Court
item.description: “When the process of adoption is completed, the adopted child becomes the legitimate child of the parents and all rights, privileges and responsibilities are bestowed on him which are attached to that relationship.” The post Adopted child entitled to caste status of adoptive parents when biological parents unknown: Bombay High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: The recommendations were made in terms of Article 224-A of the Constitution, and the Judges will hold the post for a period of two years.
